notes.title: New update for Motor Assailant
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It’s been a while! An update for Motor Assailant just went live, focused on polishing up one of the game’s rougher edges.

All mission briefing voice lines have been re-recorded with much better audio quality. The originals had their charm, but the new versions should be clearer and more enjoyable to listen to.

There’s also been some behind-the-scenes work laying the foundation for a possible future update. Nothing to announce just yet, but the wheels are turning.

Thanks for playing, and for your continued support!

notes.title: Motor Assailant update!
notes.content:
Motor Assailant has been updated! Here are the changes.

Weapons are more precise now when shooting at locked targets. This should improve the feel of the game, especially when using a gamepad or Steam Deck.
Added some distortion effect to the ingame HUD that depends on the speed of your vehicle. It can be disabled or re-enabled in the gameplay settings or by pressing F5 during the game.
Some optimizations resulted in slightly reduced game files size, also possibly some performance boost.
Some UI elements were adjusted to be more readable on Steam Deck.
Subtitles font size was increased to be more readable.

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Steam cloud save support added
Gyros and boost power are now decoupled from FPS

notes.title: Summer 2022 Update
notes.content:
One of the biggest updates so far, at least in terms of gameplay quality and usability improvements. Based heavily on the players feedback.

Patch notes:


Full gamepad support added. Might be somewhat rough around the edges but you should be able to play the game 100% with a gamepad
Option to hide/show ingame help panel
Option to hide/show the direction indicator
Option to disable screen noise and forced respawn when going in a wrong direction
Option to completely hide user interface
Camera sensitivity setting
Projectiles fired by the player will now follow the ground slightly instead of colliding with it instantly, making for a lot more enjoyable experience
Every weapon now has it's own target reticle
Separate setting added for voice volume
Voice volume will now properly obey master volume setting
Many minor changes and tweaks here and there

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Happy new year everyone! Here is the first update of 2022 for Motor Assailant.


 Fixed some typos in English localization.
 Modified the way missiles track their targets, they should now hit larger enemies with more precision. This should only affect the visual point of impact.
 Missiles will now be able to lock on The Excavator. This change should make the fight a bit easier.
 The game will no longer send any play stats to the developer. It could send completely anonymous data with explicit permission from the user related to how the game is being played, this capability will now be disabled. Request permission dialog and corresponding menu option were disabled as they are no longer necessary.

notes.title: Player feedback update
notes.content:
This update is based on player feedback and it is the biggest one so far. To celebrate it we are offering a 50% discount for the game.
List of changes:


 Added difficulty level selection. Difficulty level affects the amount of damage you receive and enemies aggressiveness. 
 Added energy shield feature. If you die multiple times in a row it will become possible to activate energy shield which will reduce the amount of damage you receive until you complete your current mission. This feature is not available on the hard difficulty setting.
 Added visual on screen indication for low armor state.
 Prices for some vehicles are reduced to make the game feel less restrictive in vehicle choice.
 Prices for vehicle upgrades are slightly reduced.
 Missiles will now first attempt to lock onto the target in the crosshair, fallback to automatic target detection if failed.
 It is now possible to revisit completed missions by picking the Missions option in the main menu.
 Added main menu background for the lava world that was missing.
 Small changes and tweaks here and there.

notes.title: Small update - added game analytics
notes.content: Added capability for the game to record and send back to us some anonymous data on how you play. The purpose of this is to improve and balance the game. No personal data is being recorded, not even your SteamID. The game will ask for your permission to send this data next time you launch it after the update.

notes.title: Weapons Update is here
notes.content:
Weapons update is finally here. It improves visuals on some of the weapons and fixes some issues.

Blaster projectiles size and visibility increased
Wave gun projectile is now wider and has a new look
Wave gun projectile now deals damage on glancing hits
Flamethrower now has a better collision
Flamethrower hits now deal damage over time
Homing and auto-locking weapons improved targeting of multi-part enemies


Some more weapon updates are planned in minor patches in the future.

notes.title: Update 3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Reduced amount of health powerups on the Space platform level 
Some minor fixes with train boss
Eye creature will no longer block the player after it's death
Retaliator main weapon damage reduced
Added some destructible and decorative elements to levels
Tweaked vehicle movement, cars should be easier to control now
Gyros power significantly increased but it will only activate if the button pressed while in air, should be less annoying
Increased damage of projectile spikes that some enemies are using
Update to the lava boss, still not completely happy with it

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Train boss win condition was bugged under certain circumstances, fixed now.
Also in this update: 

 Increased damage window to the cannon boss
 Decreased the effect of the gyros once again

notes.title: Update 2
notes.content:
Starting a new game will now correctly reset resources to default values
Any car can now be sold, including the last car you own
Some visual glitches on the ice levels are fixed

notes.title: Update 1 Notes
notes.content:
Current level environment properly displayed in the main menu (except lava environment - will be fixed later)
 Defeating the final boss now properly shows the outro scene
 Reduced the amount of eyes on some levels
 Ice levels now have proper debriefing background image
 Effect of gyros greatly reduced
 Reduced time limits for lava levels
 Moved some scenery items in lava levels to proper locations
 Removed dangling cables in the garage
 Train maximum speed slightly increased
 Train / giant cannon missiles work properly now
 Moved some pick-up items that were hard to reach
 Briefing before the cannon boss now displayed properly

notes.title: Demo update patch notes
notes.content:
Demo was updated to fix some of the issues. Please remember that the game is still WIP and the demo does not fully reflect quality of the final game.


Arena ground smoothed out a bit
Added some previously missing sound effects
Removed ability to purchase mines in the garage
Mines will now regenerate during the game up to the maximum of 10
Added ability to purchase airstrikes in the garage
Added airstrike random drop to the arena
Powerups will now have different chances to spawn in the arena based on powerup type
Lens flares will now return to normal after using boost
Tweaked missile target prioritization
Excavator boss will now track the player (remember it is not even close to being done)
Added death animation for the excavator
